Integrate six reviewed contributions while preserving partial source and
original contributor attribution.

Includes #1091, #1123, #1124, #1125, #1127 and #1128. Based on main
d5cef46cb2f83f9d7b5821dc33f5e3d12cbe01d2, retaining the new report-v1
publication/history workflow.

The five completed accuracy/hostile passes carry forward. Integration
resolves metadata by identity, preserving all contributor entries and
original provenance. Source overlaps in cu_80032EE8.cpp and
cu_8022F428.c merge automatically and already have constituent
combined-review coverage. No compiler-profile changes.

For #1091, remove the three newly proposed no-op case lines whose
numeric values are not established, retain the existing partial
initializer, and preserve target facts and the rejected experiment in
evidence. No exact credit is claimed for that function.

Final integration review and CI are pending. The six original PRs will
be closed as incorporated only after this batch merges.

Carried-forward review records are linked in the individual PRs; final
records here will identify the exact integrated revision and affected
delta.
